name: resolve-library-definitions
body: Resolve library definitions: parse the optional `groups:`, `field_sets:` and `types:` sections of each layer's `library.yaml` and resolve their references — `@<group>` in a section declaration's `accepted:`, `- include: <field_set>` in a template's `fields:`, and `type: <name>` in a field descriptor; an unknown reference is a templates error with a closest-match suggestion. The definitions are additive to library.yaml format 1 (domain.constraint.library-manifest-format-stable). Realised by solution.component.template-library-loader and solution.component.template-registry.
